bifrost: bifrost_app::url (HTTP/TLS client only); springboard/src/deildu/http.rs (shell TCP+TLS transport); springboard/netd (Wi-Fi/DHCP service, no app API)
summary: Apps get HTTP(S) requests through URLSession-style APIs, which cover the common case. Raw connections, listeners, service browsing, multicast groups, QUIC, WebSocket, framers and path monitoring exist only inside the shell and system services, with no SDK API for apps.

features.apple: URLSession (the framework page says to use URLSession for HTTP and URL loading)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/url.rs (URLSession::shared, data_task, download_task, bytes); springboard/sdk/src/url_configuration.rs (URLSessionConfiguration, CachePolicy); springboard/sdk/tests/url.rs; docs/bifrost-ui.md (URLSession section); wired: springboard/apps/news-desktop/src/feed_cache.rs (Conditional::get over bifrost_app::url::URLSession::shared().bytes); sdk/src/proxy_settings.rs (ProxySettings via URLSession::with_proxy)
features.note: HTTP/1.1 with TLS, redirects and a memory URLCache, and a URLSessionConfiguration model (request timeout cap, session headers, cache policy actions, resource expiry, connections per host; headless tests in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-34.rs). Gap: the transport does not read the configuration yet, and HTTP/2 is missing; the row needs a Midget check. Built 2026-10-17: URLSession carries its URLSessionConfiguration (request timeout caps each request, resource timeout bounds the transfer, session headers are added) and ProxySettings read from the environment in shared(); https requests tunnel through an HTTP proxy with CONNECT, plain http sends the absolute target (sdk url.rs, request_target, connect_status; tests url::tests). Gaps: HTTP/2; the cellular and waits-for-connectivity flags have no effect on PC.

features.feature: Service discovery on the local network
features.apple: NWBrowser, Bonjour (struct Bonjour, Bonjour Listener Provider)
features.bifrost: springboard/core/src/dns_browse.rs, springboard/sdk/src/network_browser.rs; springboard/core/tests/parity_sdk-tests-05.rs; wired: springboard/core/src/dns_browse.rs via springboard/src/shell/services/network_path.rs and springboard/sdk/src/network_path.rs (partial: browse lifecycle only, no daemon); sdk/src/avahi_publish.rs (Publication)
features.note: Service type rules, browse and resolve replies, and name building are tested headless in core/tests/parity_sdk-tests-05.rs, and the SDK exposes the browser under its own names in sdk/src/network_browser.rs. The shell's network service runs browse references over this model. Gaps: replies are fed in, with no socket or daemon query; there is no advertise or registration API; and the nearby-sharing beacon is a private protocol, not DNS-SD. Verify on Midget for parity. Built 2026-10-17: Bonjour advertising through Avahi: sdk avahi_publish::Publication runs avahi-publish-service for a listener's Service and port and withdraws it on drop (tests avahi_publish::tests). Browsing is still fed by hand; no socket query.

Group membership rules, the 224.0.0.0/4 range and send options are tested headless in springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-os-05.rs. Gap: the model opens no socket, so the shell's join is not driven by it, and apps still cannot join a group. Built 2026-10-17: sdk network_group::ConnectionGroup binds a UDP socket, joins and leaves IPv4 groups through the membership model (invalid joins refused before the socket), sends to a group, receives without blocking, and sets TTL and loopback; tests network_group::tests. Gap: std::net has no SO_REUSEADDR, so two groups cannot share one port on a host; not checked on Midget. Built 2026-10-17: SO_REUSEADDR is set on the group socket (Linux, through the C library) so several groups share a port.
Niche raw-frame access. No app need in the desktop, and no SDK plan
